note: Text stand-ins for the keyframes that VisualClaw's cascade gate (Cascade-8) forwards from the walkthrough clip. The adapter stages each description as _clip_frames/<MM_SS>.jpg, and the backbone receives it in place of the image attachment.

keyframes.description: Site gate. Worker #11: white hard hat, orange hi-vis vest, clear safety glasses over the eyes. Worker #12: hard hat and hi-vis vest, no safety glasses.

Scaffold base. Worker #13: hard hat, vest, safety glasses on. Worker #14: vest and glasses on, hard hat held in the hand, bare head. Worker #15: hard hat and vest, safety glasses pushed up onto the brim of the hat.
Crusher zone, yellow hatching on the ground. Worker #16: hard hat, vest, glasses and red ear muffs. Worker #17: hard hat, vest and glasses, no ear muffs or plugs visible.
Rebar yard. Worker #18: hard hat, vest, glasses and work gloves. Worker #19: hard hat and glasses, grey T-shirt, no hi-vis vest.
Concrete pour. Workers #20 and #21: hard hats, vests, safety glasses on. Worker #22: hard hat and vest, no safety glasses.
Crusher zone, second pass. Worker #23: hard hat, vest, glasses, orange foam ear plugs visible. Worker #24: hard hat, vest and ear muffs, no safety glasses.
Site office ramp. Worker #25: hard hat, vest, glasses. Worker #26: hard hat, vest, glasses, bare hands (no gloves).
Loading bay. Worker #27: baseball cap instead of a hard hat, vest and glasses on. Worker #28: hard hat, vest, glasses.
